{"metadata":{"description":"Session usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: price, tokens, per-turn curves, and per-answer cost badges.","id":"gh:1449224746","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-session-usage","slug":"Cottins-Vanilla/dsh-session-usage","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Session usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: price, tokens, per-turn curves, and per-answer cost ba"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"on usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: price, tokens, per-turn curves, and per-answer cost badges."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Session Usage for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness plugin that answers one question for every conversation:

conversation's View tabs, the session header, and the end of every answer."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Surfaces"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| Surface | Where | What it shows |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| **Usage panel** | Sidebar → **会话用量 / Session usage** | The full dashboard: KPIs, daily and per-tur"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"n curves, conversation list |
| **Usage tab** | Conversation View tabs → **用量 / Usage** | The same d"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ashboard, scoped to the open conversation |
| **Session header chip** | Right side of the conversati"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"on header | Current conversation price and total tokens; click to open the panel |
| **Turn price ba"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"dge** | After every completed answer | `本轮 ¥… · 当前对话 ¥…` — this turn's price first, then the convers"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"ation total, with a white default and a configurable accent |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- **Five metrics** — price, total tokens, input tokens, output tokens, and
cache-read tokens.
- **Th"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"ree scopes** — current conversation, current project (the conversation's
working directory), or all "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"conversations. Every scope names its target: the
conversation title, the project folder, or the numb"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"er of conversations.
- **Per-turn and daily curves** — a zero-filled daily curve, a per-turn value
c"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"urve for the current conversation, and a per-turn cumulative curve.
- **每轮值 / Per-turn value** is av"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"ailable only for the current conversation:
each point is that turn alone, with no accumulation.
- Th"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"e per-turn cumulative curve gives the eight most expensive conversations
their own colors and folds "},{"id":"p11s8","text":"the rest into a gray **other conversations**
series.
- A legend shows the color, title, project, and"},{"id":"p11s9","text":" total for each series; click a
legend item to hide or show that conversation.
- Hover any point to "},{"id":"p11s10","text":"inspect the value of every visible series.
- **Click-through** — every conversation row opens that c"},{"id":"p11s11","text":"onversation, and
clicking a per-turn chart point or a turn detail row switches from the Usage
tab ba"},{"id":"p11s12","text":"ck to Chat and lands on that turn. The current-conversation view also
lists each turn.
- **Turn cost"},{"id":"p11s13","text":" badges** — after each answer, the badge shows that turn's price
first, then the conversation total "},{"id":"p11s14","text":"up to that answer. The default is white; the
panel's **标记颜色 / Badge color** control offers white, co"},{"id":"p11s15","text":"lor presets, and a
custom color picker. The choice is stored locally.
- **Live enough** — the panel "},{"id":"p11s16","text":"refreshes every 15 seconds, the header chip every
8 seconds, and turn badges share one request per c"},{"id":"p11s17","text":"onversation.
- **Update check** — on each Harness login the plugin checks the latest GitHub
release "},{"id":"p11s18","text":"once, and offers a manual **Check for updates** button. A newer release
shows a release link and a r"},{"id":"p11s19","text":"ed dot on the button. The Host caches the result for
six hours.
- **Bilingual** — complete English a"},{"id":"p11s20","text":"nd Simplified Chinese dictionaries.
- **Read-only by design** — no session-log writes, no profile ed"},{"id":"p11s21","text":"its, no
third-party network calls except the update check, and no telemetry."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### Requirements"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.2-rc.1** (tested) with the Web UI.
- Node.js **22.19+**.
- A profile with t"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"**0.2.2-rc.1** (tested) with the Web UI.
- Node.js **22.19+**.
- A profile with the Web app enabled."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Option A — install from this repository"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"In the Web UI, open **Plugins → Add plugin**, choose the GitHub source, and enter:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Or with the CLI, using the profile name that owns your Web UI:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### Option B — install a local checkout"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Data, privacy, and security"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- **Source of truth** — the committed Session log. Live sessions are folded from
the in-memory store"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"; cold sessions are read through
`sessionQuery.readSession()`. The plugin never appends events and n"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ever writes
session data.
- **No external network by default** — the only routine HTTP request is th"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"e
same-origin, authenticated `POST /api/session-usage/query` between this
bundle's Client and Host h"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"alves. The update check (once per Harness login or
the manual button) makes one Host-side request to"},{"id":"p24s6","text":" `api.github.com`; the Host
caches the result for six hours. No data about you or your sessions is s"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"ent.
- **No telemetry** — nothing is reported to the author or a third party.
- **No secrets** — the"},{"id":"p24s8","text":" plugin reads token counts and model ids, not credentials
or account data. The only message text it "},{"id":"p24s9","text":"retains is a short fallback title
(up to 120 characters) derived from the first user message when th"},{"id":"p24s10","text":"e session has
no title event.
- **Bounded work** — `maxSessions` caps the scan; the query route is r"},{"id":"p24s11","text":"ead-only;
failed sessions are isolated and reported as a warning count."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"See SECURITY.md for reporting a vulnerability."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"The Host keeps a derived in-memory index; it is a cache, not a second source of
truth. The Client re"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"nders with theme tokens, does not import Harness Client
packages, and reads session data only throug"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"h the Host response."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"More detail: docs/architecture.md."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Compatibility and known limitations"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- Tested with DeepSeek Harness **0.2.2-rc.1**, Web platform only.
- Prices are estimates; the bundle"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"d 2026 holiday table must be updated for later
years. Override `pricing.models` and `pricing.holiday"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"s` for other providers or
new prices.
- The first **All conversations** query can take a moment on a"},{"id":"p31s4","text":" large history
because cold logs are read once; later queries are incremental.
- "Current project" c"},{"id":"p31s5","text":"ompares recorded `cwd` values using platform case rules
(insensitive on Windows, sensitive on POSIX)"},{"id":"p31s6","text":"; it is not a full workspace
registry mapping.
- The npm package name `dsh-session-usage` is occupie"},{"id":"p31s7","text":"d by an unrelated project.
This repository is distributed as a GitHub/local bundle. See
docs/publish"},{"id":"p31s8","text":"ing.md before attempting an npm release.
